title: EIT-LJ Cube Bifurcations (Paper 3): code, certificates and audit records
description:
Code, rigorous computer-assisted certificates, certificate checkers, tests, negative controls, proof dependency graphs, independent audit records and manuscript sources for the paper Symmetry-Breaking Bifurcations from the Cubic Equilibrium in Two-Term Inverse-Power Clusters (Toni Mladenovski, Mihail Mladenski; EITNetworks LLC, Tobyhanna, Pennsylvania, USA).

For eight identical particles with V(r) = A r-p - B r-q (A, B > 0, p > q > 0) the paper classifies the local branches born from the cubic equilibrium at the transition curves of Paper 2: a Z2 pitchfork of Td configurations at the A2u curve (supercritical in the reduced-energy convention); transcritical D3d branches and a Z2 pitchfork of D2h branches at the T2g curve; and the inertia of the D2h branch points: centre (1, 0, 2), slice (4, 0, 14), R24 (4, 6, 14) (negative/zero/positive; the six raw zeros are rigid motions). No stability is claimed.

Computer-assisted results use Arb ball arithmetic with independent checkers; each phase has an independent blind computational audit by a separate AI system (not journal peer review). The use of AI tools is documented in docs/AI_USE_LOG.md.
